messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Problems with Corine Land Cover Data in Wallace
parts:
Hi Beni,
It looks like the problem is with a conflict in the coordinate reference system of the land cover data you are using. Wallace typically uses WGS 84. 
I'll take a look into if this is the problem. In the meantime you can try reprojecting your rasters into WGS84 and see if that works.
